title: What Jungle Canopy Cities Is
definition: Jungle Canopy Cities: cities woven through rainforest canopies without clearing.
description:
Jungle Canopy Cities — Signature Edition: cities woven through rainforest canopies without clearing. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature canopy hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: treetop districts rethought, cable transit rebuilt, biodiversity corridors reimagined for the century ahead. Nothing here is presented as established fact — it is a designed future, fully specified.

This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the stilt blocks ambition that defines the Signature line.

t: The Signature Vision: Jungle Canopy Cities
title: The Signature Vision: Jungle Canopy Cities
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Jungle Canopy Cities.
description:
The Signature vision of Jungle Canopy Cities does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature canopy hulls program, charter one: master treetop districts at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale cable transit manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate biodiversity corridors systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Jungle Canopy Cities becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

Builders sequence this piece early because every other component assumes it works. In the Signature architecture this piece is designed first-class, not bolted on.

t: 2030 — The first canopy hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first canopy hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Jungle Canopy Cities roadmap.
description:
The first canopy hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its treetop districts grid and cable transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the treetop districts results have to replicate outside the lab, cable transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and biodiversity corridors operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed treetop districts demonstrations, cable transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting biodiversity corridors uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Jungle Canopy Cities
definition: Estimates Jungle Canopy Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Jungle Canopy Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a canopy hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Jungle Canopy Cities Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Jungle Canopy Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Jungle Canopy Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 32375 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where treetop districts monitoring, cable transit redundancy, or biodiversity corridors maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Jungle Canopy Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Jungle Canopy Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Jungle Canopy Cities — cities woven through rainforest canopies without clearing.

Phase 1 — Prove (treetop districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (cable transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (biodiversity corridors): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (stilt blocks): canopy hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and rainforest-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
